A '''species''' of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] were small, predatory creatures native to the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. While considered cute and cuddly, the animals could become agitated when restless. When restless, they would bite or claw the perpetrator.<ref name=":0">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>

When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Cindel Towani]] visited Endor, the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] allowed her to play with one who was quite clearly scared of the child.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Ewok Adventure'' contained many real animals, such as [[Horse/Legends|horses]], [[Unidentified Endorian goat creature|goats]], [[Unidentified Endor quadruped|llamas]] and lizards, as well as ferrets, who were used for this species.<ref name=":0" />

When Cindel is playing with the ferret, it is obviously quite scared, since it tries to bite her at least twice.<ref name=":0" />

In the episode of the animated Ewoks series titled "[[The Curse of the Jindas]]", a character called [[Chituhr]] performs a circus act on Endor with creatures referred to onscreen in the episode as [[ferret]]s. Since the species of the creature in ''The Ewok Adventure'' has not been given an official name, it is unclear if it it intended to be the same species as the ferrets from the animated episode.
